title: Decide whether task-scoped memory capture and context packets stay, since neither ever reached production
outcome: Greg decides whether task-scoped memory capture, task-memory search and the context-packet design stay (with a production surface) or are removed. Project memory (remember, memories, forget) is the live use of the same memory model and is not in question.
acceptance: Greg's keep-or-remove decision is recorded on this item, covering task-scoped capture (capture_note), task-memory search (search_memories, show_memory) and the context-packet design (spec §4, context-packets.md)

If removal is chosen, the removal separates task memories from project memories by scope, never by object kind: both share the memory_assertion_event kind, which doctor, the memory projection rebuild and graph-snapshot load all handle
Spec §4, context-packets.md, typed-memory-model.md, vision.md and roadmap.md match the decision
